source_title: Ajay Devgn moves Bombay HC over FDA’s pan masala ad notice

When the notices were served, the brands as well as the actors were asked to get the ads removed from all media platforms and provide explanations.There have not been any public statements by the actors regarding the show-cause notices.Speaking to the press, Mundhe said, âHearings have been completed by the assistant commissioner. She will be filing an adjudication case before the joint commissioner by next week; the adjudication process will hence begin.âHe said even despite Devgnâs case in court now, the proceedings will continue as per the rules until any further directions from the court.The actors were asked to furnish complete details regarding endorsement contracts, distribution channels, and proof of whether Vimal Elaichi is an independent product available for sale.Vimal Pan Masala is a smokeless tobacco product that is a product prohibited for manufacture, storage, transportation, distribution, and sale in the state.India carries a massive burden of oral cancer, accounting for roughly 30% of global cases, largely due to the prevalence of smokeless tobacco.
